evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: This raises two questions: does a model asked to solve a case abstain when the input is defective, and when it does not, can the same model catch the defect when asked instead to verify the input?

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Accuracy on clean benchmarks says nothing about how a model behaves then, and a system that computes straight through a defective input returns a confident number with no sign that anything is wrong.
